title: Mailchimp - All-in-one email/SMS marketing platform for small businesses
clean_text: Mailchimp is an email and SMS marketing platform, acquired by Intuit in 2021, that has grown into an all-in-one digital marketing platform connecting email, SMS, social scheduling, ads, landing pages, and a Customer Journey Builder under shared audience data and unified reporting, with 300+ integrations. It targets businesses wanting marketing automation without enterprise-level complexity or cost, serving everyone from solo creators to global ecommerce brands, and remains positioned as a user-friendly entry point for beginners in digital marketing.

meta.target: solo creators and small businesses through global ecommerce brands
